(n : ℕ) (hn : Even n) (W : ℚ[X])
    (hstrong : StrongProperMultiplier n W) (hzero : aggregate n W = 0) (t : ℚ)
    (hregular : ∀ k ≤ n, t + (k : ℚ) ≠ 0) :
    CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t = telescoper n W t - telescoper n W (t + 1)

ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telesc.original_signature:
(n : ℕ) (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) (W : ℚ[X]) (t : ℚ)
    (hregular : ∀ k < n, t + (k : ℚ) ≠ 0) :
    telescoper n W t = (telescoperNumerator n W).eval t / (polePolynomial (n - 1)).eval t ^ 9
